title: Complete in Thee
lyrics_original: Among Thy chosen will I be,
And glorified, I too, shall be!

bible_verses.english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;
For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us. Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from wrath through him.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the incredible gift of Your complete salvation. Forgive me for the times I try to earn the grace You so freely purchased with Jesus' blood. Help me to rest deeply in the truth that I am justified, sanctified, and fully accepted in Him. May my heart overflow with gratitude today as I walk in the joy of being complete in Your love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: We often spend so much energy trying to prove our worth, yet Jesus offers us total completeness through His sacrifice. His grace forgives our past, justifies our present, and secures our future without any merit of our own. Resting in His finished work frees us from the exhausting weight of self-reliance. As we sing these truth-filled words, let us lay down our striving and rejoice in the eternal fullness we already possess in Christ.
